picks.what: General view, wood engraving in the weekly Tygodnik Powszechny
picks.why: the only general view before 1900: roofs of the old town under its church towers, seen over gardens; very high resolution; trimmed the mount and caption

picks.what: View over the town from a height, colored postcard
picks.why: color bird’s-eye view of the 19th-century center with the domed church on the right; trimmed the printed title in the sky

gaps: P0–P3: nothing usable (#1 is a costume plate, not a view). P6: no candidates.
notes: #3: Commons dates the postcard 1917 (probably a postmark), so the label says ‘about 1917’; despite the file name it is a view from a tower, not an aerial photograph. #2 is a clipping from Tygodnik Powszechny, 1885 (caption ‘Widok ogólny Radomia’).
